name: MulAction.orbit
type: (γ : Type u) → {α : Type v} → [SMul γ α] → α → Set α
provides: The set of all scalar-action images of an element; for the supplied orthogonal subgroup action this is precisely the group orbit.
type_review: Expanded only the section variables used by the range-of-action definition; no monoid law is required by this underlying orbit definition, and no compiled elaborator dump was used.
